title: What If Paper Money Was Never Invented?
sources: Premise is fictional. Supporting mechanics: Encyclopaedia Britannica, money — the first coins were struck in Lydia around 600 BC, while the earliest paper money appeared in China around 1000 AD
United States Mint, coin specifications — a circulating quarter weighs 5.67 g, so $100 in quarters is about 2.3 kg of metal
Encyclopaedia Britannica, pound (unit of weight) — the monetary and weight pound both descend from the ancient Roman libra, a balance that weighed out metal

lines.text: You grab a coffee, drop a clinking pouch of bronze coins on the counter.
lines.caps: You grab a *coffee, | drop a *clinking pouch | of *bronze coins | on the *counter.

lines.text: No paper bills means a thick leather belt and pockets that sag.
